title: Smaller than I thought, and not as sturdy.
text: Smaller than I thought, and not as sturdy.. This was a tad smaller than I envisioned. And part of the plastic was misshaped in the lowest ring. It's not very sturdy plasic.  I am hoping it will work for our wedding macaroon tower. I will update once our wedding has happened & I can add photos.

features: Made of high quality clear PVC; Simply design, light weight, easy to use, hand washable and reusable.
This removable macaron tower consists of 6 individual clear stackable plastic levels; Adjustable tiers and can be used with just 2 or up to 6 tiers.
Height 10.2", diameter at bottom 9", space between tiers is 2 inches; Can hold approximately 92-95 macarons (varies depending on each macaron size).
Use this macaroon stand to display your colorful and sweet desserts, cake, cupcake, cookie, macaron and more.
Ideal for various banquets such as wedding, engagement, birthday, party, baby shower, thanksgiving day, christmas and etc.
